astronauts.name: Neil A. Armstrong
astronauts.description: Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon as Commander of Apollo 11 on July 20, 1969. He was also a naval aviator, test pilot, and aeronautical engineer.

astronauts.name: Edwin E. Aldrin Jr.
astronauts.description: Buzz Aldrin was one of the first two humans to land on the Moon alongside Neil Armstrong during Apollo 11 in 1969. He also flew on Gemini 12, performing three spacewalks.

astronauts.name: Michael Collins
astronauts.description: Collins served as Command Module Pilot for Apollo 11, orbiting the Moon 30 times while Armstrong and Aldrin made the first lunar landing. He was the first person to perform more than one spacewalk.

astronauts.name: Alan B. Shepard Jr.
astronauts.description: Shepard was the first American to travel into space in 1961 and later walked on the Moon during Apollo 14 in 1971. He was one of the original NASA Mercury Seven astronauts.

astronauts.name: James A. Lovell Jr.
astronauts.description: Lovell flew four times in space, including as Command Module Pilot of Apollo 8 and Commander of the ill-fated Apollo 13 mission. He was the first person to fly into space four times.

missions.name: Apollo 1
missions.description: A cabin fire during a launch rehearsal on January 27, 1967 killed all three crew members and destroyed the command module.

missions.name: Apollo 7
missions.description: The first crewed Apollo mission, it tested the command and service module in low Earth orbit.

missions.name: Apollo 8
missions.description: The first crewed spacecraft to orbit the Moon. The crew were the first humans to witness an Earthrise.

missions.name: Apollo 9
missions.description: The first flight of the full Apollo spacecraft, qualifying the Lunar Module for lunar operations.

missions.name: Apollo 10
missions.description: A full dress rehearsal for the Moon landing, flying the Lunar Module to within 8.4 nautical miles of the surface.

missions.name: Apollo 11
missions.description: The first mission to land humans on the Moon. Armstrong and Aldrin landed on July 20, 1969.

missions.name: Apollo 12
missions.description: The second Moon landing, touching down in the Ocean of Storms four months after Apollo 11.

missions.name: Apollo 13
missions.description: An oxygen tank failure forced the crew to abort the Moon landing and loop around the Moon to return safely.

missions.name: Apollo 14
missions.description: The third Moon landing and first in the lunar highlands, commanded by Alan Shepard.

missions.name: Apollo 15
missions.description: The first J mission and first use of the Lunar Roving Vehicle, exploring near Hadley Rille.

missions.name: Apollo 16
missions.description: The fifth Moon landing and second in the lunar highlands, lasting 11 days.

missions.name: Apollo 17
missions.description: The final Apollo mission and last time humans traveled beyond low Earth orbit.
